== Silk Skills ==
[[File:Silk Skills Heading.png|center]]

<b>{{CrestSlot|Skill|s}}</b> are abilities that are equipped within [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet's]] [[Crest]] which deplete 4 [[Silk]] when used.<ref group="Note">Lowered to 3 Silk when at full health with [[Egg of Flealia]] equipped.</ref> Their damage scales with the upgrade level of the [[Needle]], and can be increased further with [[Volt Filament]] and the [[Shaman Crest]].

{| class="article-table" width="100%" data-tracking-id="skills-table"
! style="width: 8rem;" | [[File:Silkspear.png|link=Silkspear|72x72px]]
[[Silkspear]]
| <i>Attack by throwing the needle forward. Silk will be expended.</i>
| 3x [[Needle]]
|-
! [[File:Thread Storm.png|link=Thread Storm|72x72px]]
[[Thread Storm]]
| <i>Attack by whipping a storm of Silk around oneself.</i>
| (0.75x [[Needle]]) x 4 + (0.25x [[Needle]]) + ([[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)#Needle|Needle Level]]) x 6
|-
! [[File:Cross Stitch.png|link=Cross Stitch|72x72px]]
[[Cross Stitch]]
| <i>Bind Silk around the needle to deflect enemy attacks and instantly strike back.</i>
| (0.75 x [[Needle]]) x 4
|-
! [[File:Sharpdart.png|link=Sharpdart|72x72px]]
[[Sharpdart]]
| <i>Pierce through enemies in a blur of blade and Silk.</i>
| (2.75x [[Needle]]) + <br> (0.25x [[Needle]]) x3
|-
! [[File:Rune Rage.png|link=Rune Rage|72x72px]]
[[Rune Rage]]
| <i>Weave runes of blazing Silk upon enemies.</i>
| <math>\frac{\text{2.1x Needle Damage}}{n}</math><br>For n<sup>th</sup> rune on the same enemy
|-
! [[File:Pale Nails.png|link=Pale Nails|72x72px]]
[[Pale Nails]]
| <i>Spin lethal talons from thread that seek out enemies.</i>
| 1x [[Needle]] per projectile
|}

== Ancestral Arts ==
<b>Ancestral Arts</b> are skills Hornet can acquire throughout the game to make traversing [[Pharloom]] easier.

{| class="article-table" width="100%"
! style="width: 8rem;" | [[File:Icon SS Swift Step Splash.png|link=Swift Step|72x72px]]
[[Swift Step]]
| <i>Sprint at blinding speed, beyond one's natural limits.<br>
Chase down prey and leap great distances.</i>
|-
! [[File:Icon SS Cling Grip Splash.png|link=Cling Grip|72x72px]]
[[Cling Grip]]
| <i>Cling to sheer surfaces and leap to rapidly scale heights.</i>
|-
! [[File:Icon SS Needolin Splash.png|link=Needolin|72x72px]]
[[Needolin]]
| <i>Play ancient melodies by stringing Silk along the needle.<br>
Silk will be expended. Strike enemies to replenish Silk.</i>
|-
! [[File:Icon SS Clawline Splash.png|link=Clawline|72x72px]]
[[Clawline]]
| <i>Fling the needle as a harpoon and launch forcefully towards it.<br>
Silk will be expended. Strike enemies to replenish Silk.</i>
|-
! [[File:Icon SS Silk Soar Splash.png|link=Silk Soar|72x72px]]
[[Silk Soar]]
| <i>Fling the needle upwards and launch to tremendous heights.<br>
Silk will be expended. Strike enemies to replenish Silk.</i>
|-
! [[File:Icon SS Sylphsong Splash.png|link=Sylphsong|72x72px]]
[[Sylphsong]]
| <i>Eva's soul and strength reside within.<br>
Silk will regenerate when resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]].</i>
|}
